what_this_is: Five situations put to the frozen-pairing check that batch 30 rebuilt, one of them driven by the clean-room run's own conclusions.csv -- the data that stopped batch 27 at the last script in the tree.

drifted_frozen_figures.what_it_does: swaps in the clean-room run's conclusions.csv and its own distribution.json -- the numbers the old version died on, with the band that run measured -- and re-runs the comparison
drifted_frozen_figures.why_this_is_the_test: batch 27 had exactly these 32 drifted figures and zero moved pairings, and exited 1 at the last script in the tree with every held-out analysis already scored

pairing_moved.what_it_does: removes main from the development table, so a frozen row is paired with an analysis the tree no longer concludes
pairing_moved.said: main__holdout: frozen against main, which the development table no longer carries
pairing_moved.why: a moved pairing is the comparison being about something other than what it says, which is the only difference that can make the reported answer wrong. It stops before anything is written

twin_without_a_conclusion.what_it_does: blanks main's skill score, keeping the row
twin_without_a_conclusion.why: the frozen figure is a record of what was paired and stands on its own; the twin's absence from today's table is worth reporting and is not a reason to refuse to report the comparison

beats_reference_comes_from_the_freeze.what_it_does: inverts beats_reference on all 32 development rows and re-runs
beats_reference_comes_from_the_freeze.why: a reported phase-E count that follows a re-derived table is the same defect as a frozen figure re-asserted against one, three lines away

the_output_is_stable.what_it_does: re-runs the comparison on the archived tree and hashes the three files it writes, before and after
the_output_is_stable.why: the comparison is arithmetic over stored scores and reads no clock, so a re-run of it must reproduce the archive exactly
